title: Still Orbit — A pocket observatory
description: A contemplative Three.js solar-system explorer with a graphite-and-parchment palette, procedural planet surfaces, responsive field-note panel, labeled planet collection, gentle focus transitions, and accessible playback and camera controls.
features: Eight animated selectable planets, procedural local textures, Saturn rings, orbit paths, sunlight, sparse stars, and a selection halo
Pointer orbit, wheel and pinch zoom, keyboard camera movement, zoom buttons, overview, and follow-selected-planet view
Pause/resume, five simulation speeds, elapsed model days, reset, and reduced-motion-aware initial state
Responsive planet facts, HTML selection controls, visible keyboard focus, status announcements, and explicit scale/motion disclaimers
Readable WebGL creation/context-loss fallback with continued planet information access

tests.name: Local Vite production bundle without filesystem output
tests.command: node --input-type=module; import { build } from 'vite'; import { resolve } from 'node:path'; await build({ root: resolve('experiments/planetary/astra-xhigh-refined'), configFile: false, logLevel: 'warn', build: { write: false, emptyOutDir: false } });

knownLimitations: Browser/runtime and visual checks were not run because localhost browser access is unavailable and prohibited by the brief.
Planet sizes, spacing, rotations, orbital geometry, and periods are deliberately stylized; outer orbital periods are compressed.
Planet surface maps and the selected-world portrait are original procedural illustrations rather than scientific imagery.
WebGL fallback and graphics-context-loss handling are implemented but were not browser-tested.
